Only 1-2px dark columns at the left and right edges suggest cut walls. No south-facing vertical face of 3 or more rows is drawn, so the whole tile is a horizontal surface seen from above.

The banding also looks sticker-like, a uniform outlined slab with little surface variation. A careful artist would not accept it next to the references as equally rich.
